name: Runner Extras - error raised inside an async-emitted subscriber
brief: Proves an Error() raised in a subscriber that itself raises an event reaches the original publisher's caller instead of being silently discarded.
description: AL subscribers are not always emitted as synchronous methods — BC emits an async state machine whenever the body needs one, and a subscriber that RAISES ANOTHER EVENT always does (its body awaits RunEventAsync). An exception raised underneath such a subscriber is captured by the state machine and surfaced on its returned task; a dispatcher that discards that task discards the error. The publisher then continues as though the subscriber had succeeded. Measured on a real ISV report renderer: the AL author's own 'LF-XML: The template is not well-formed XML' error was thrown, dropped, and the platform handed the caller an EMPTY PDF while Report.SaveAs reported success — the test then failed with a misleading 'Not a native PDF'. This is the exact two-level topology of that chain (platform trigger codeunit → System App ReportManagement → ISV subscriber), reduced to first-party AL.
